statusBar.mockStopped: Status bar item that opens the mock server. The mock server answers requests from saved examples on this computer.
statusBar.mockRunning: Same item while the server is running.
statusBar.mockRunningOn: Same item while the server is running; {{port}} is the port number.
statusBar.captureStopped: Status bar item that opens traffic capture, a proxy that records calls from another app.
statusBar.captureRunning: Same item while the capture is running.
statusBar.git: Status bar item that opens the Git panel. Git is a product name.
statusBar.detached: Git term: HEAD is not on a branch. Keep HEAD.
